source_of_truth.resolution_rule: All field types, required flags, enums, relations, source write guards, node inputs and outputs, envelope fields, workflow triggers and source steps are resolved from this manifest at execution time.

onsite_entry_gate.rule: Use the actual P01-P13 result branch. Untested capabilities remain untested and are never inferred from visible product entries.

field_contract_resolution.effective_field_order: logical.common_fields in source order, followed by logical.tables[canonical_table_key].fields in source order
field_contract_resolution.rule: No type, required flag, enum or relation target may be invented or overridden in this package. Unsupported physical types stop the build and require a documented adapter decision from the controller.

source_type_to_proposed_feishu_type.json: 多行文本加 JSON 结构校验

physical_field_mapping_draft.required_enforcement: Where the platform supports required fields, enforce the logical required flag directly. Otherwise use a protected preflight view or verified automation/manual checklist and record P02 as limited; never silently weaken the logical contract.
physical_field_mapping_draft.unsupported_type_stop: Record F04 and request a controller adapter decision. This draft mapping is not proof that the tenant supports the physical type.

raw_json_field_visibility_contracts.proposed_physical_type: 多行文本加 JSON 结构校验

field_protection_resolution.resolution_assertion: Every one of the 240 effective fields must resolve to exactly one category by first-match precedence. Action overlays narrow transitions but never create another field contract.
field_protection_resolution.fallback_rule: If the tenant cannot enforce a category, use a protected view plus an explicit human checklist, keep the fallback verification status untested until exercised, and record P03/P06 as limited.

build_phases.action: Select the documented branch from actual P01-P13 evidence; do not change an untested result.
Create ten empty table shells in table_build_order, without importing data or adding relations.
Resolve the effective field order from the logical manifest and create common plus non-relation fields.
Create relation fields only after every target table shell exists, in relation_build_order.
Verify that the frozen logical contract contains zero formula fields. Do not add lookup or formula helper fields.
Apply the global overlay and each table protection plan; verify with an unprivileged account when P03 permits.
Create five business views; cross-table fields remain linked-record drill-downs and do not become new canonical fields.
Document three logical visibility groups and human gates without claiming a real Feishu role mapping.
When P04 evidence permits, configure N1-N7 against the shared envelope; otherwise install the manual execution and audit fallback only.
When P05 evidence permits, configure workflow phases in integration_order; otherwise use protected status fields, checklists and audit entries.
Run positive, boundary and failure checks, fill evidence units, then freeze the resource mapping locally.

formula_and_dependency_policy.decision: Do not add formula or lookup fields to the frozen ten-table contract. Cross-table information is opened through relation drill-down. Any future physical helper field requires controller approval and a schema revision.

ai_runtime_policy.human_fallback: If a real AI attempt exists, preserve its actual envelope and route the failure to human after at most one repair retry. If P04 is unavailable and no AI attempt occurred, record only a manual-fallback evidence entry and never fabricate an ai_audit run.

workflows.error_stop: Do not overwrite the existing business record; stop on same key with different content and route to human.
workflows.rollback: Preserve original text, authorization scope, idempotency key and any existing record; mark the partial attempt for review instead of deleting evidence.

workflows.error_stop: After one same-version schema repair retry, stop the chain, keep the feedback, set the documented manual-processing path and write an error audit.
workflows.rollback: Never lower a hard-rule risk or delete the source feedback; restore no state silently and hand off with the original status and audit trail visible.

workflows.error_stop: Do not invent an identifier or create an accepted work order when evidence is weak or either confirmation is absent.
workflows.rollback: Keep candidate suggestions as candidates, preserve the SLA start, return the case to the documented missing-information state and retain any draft work-order audit.

workflows.error_stop: On notification or automation failure, keep the original business status and SLA start, notify the administrator through the verified fallback and stop status advancement.
workflows.rollback: Disable only the failing temporary automation; never reset SLA start, erase escalation history or mark the work order completed.

workflows.error_stop: Insufficient evidence, abnormal follow-up or absent review returns the case to processing; no external reply or closure is automatic.
workflows.rollback: Keep the draft reply and evidence as reviewable audit data, restore no closed claim and return to the prior processing state with the SLA history intact.

workflows.error_stop: Keep same-event candidates separate until reviewed; reject active-observation intake without the exact N5 receipt and separate human authorization. Run the same Day-7 cutoff guard before receipt issue and against the latest authoritative state inside the full lock before state-fingerprint CAS and business commit: once Day-7 is sealed, closed_at <= day7ExpectedAt including the equal millisecond is rejected, while only closed_at > day7ExpectedAt inside the base window is Day-30 eligible. For enter_observation, await observation-phase human authorization with zero resource locks, then revalidate trusted time and commit atomically under the full case/cluster/improvement lock. Run record_day_7 and record_day_30 as separate deterministic transactions with no caller actor, AI or authorizer; only committed same-cycle intake/reopen history is eligible, Day-30 is cumulative, and a null denominator keeps recurrence_rate null. Preserve cases, feedback, work orders and the prior observation state on authorization, clock, lock, CAS, source or denominator failure.
workflows.rollback: For intake_active_observation_recurrence, a Day-7 cutoff rejection at the final full-lock guard occurs after the private N5 validation and human authorization capabilities may already be consumed: record capability_consumption=consumed separately, business_commit=rejected, business_writes=[] and w6_state_writes=[]; preserve the checkpoint-first state and do not restore or relabel consumed capabilities as business writes. For enter_observation, denial, invalid grant, trusted-clock drift, lock conflict or CAS conflict leaves the prior cluster/improvement and runtime observation state unchanged. For record_day_7 and record_day_30, wrong clock/cycle/horizon, missing Day-7, non-cumulative or uncommitted sources, invalid denominator, lock drift or commit failure appends no checkpoint/history/receipt and changes no business state. If any D1 business commit succeeds while workflow audit append fails, keep the committed business result with audit_pending; replay the same workflow_audit_id to repair only the audit and never repeat N5, human authorization or business writes; never regenerate IDs, invoke AI or replay any D1 business write. On business failure preserve cases.cluster_id/status, raw_feedback ownership/status, cluster/improvement status, the improvement record and observation cycle. Preserve work orders in every observation action. Do not auto-archive, reopen, publish knowledge, declare a final root cause or delete recurrence evidence.
